377YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Ynez of the League became Cardinal of Prosperity, Asher of Highguard Cardinal of Courage, Jared of Highguard Cardinal of Loyalty and Samson of Highguard Cardinal of Pride, each after the previous holder was removed or contested. The General Assembly vetoed the Senate's decision to give the Brilliant Shore Bourse resource to Wintermark. The Assembly of Prosperity condemned Xavier Cascade for heresy and blasphemy, 90 to 0. A Statement of Principle now requires an Exemplar to win both a Greater Majority of the relevant Virtue Assembly and a Lesser Majority of the General Assembly, and to name the signs shown. The Marches Hospital, Phoenix Spire, Celesti Coven and Caleb of the Cenotaph each received one and a half Thrones. Proposed rewards to Azmon and to Lazarus of the Shattered Tower were defeated.

Dawn.t: Abaddon De Rondell of Dawn held the post of Cardinal of Wisdom. Lady Josephine Novarrion of Dawn lost the contest for Cardinal of Pride narrowly, by 50 votes to 54, while Avery Armistead of Dawn received 10.

Highguard.t: Highborn priests won three Cardinal seats, with Asher taking Courage, Jared taking Loyalty and Samson taking Pride, and Ira of Highguard secured the Synod's backing for a monument at Anvil to the Empire's military dead. Proposed rewards to Azmon and Lazarus of the Shattered Tower, raised by Highborn priests, were both defeated.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Assembly of Pride formally called on the Imperial Orcs to form a National Assembly in the Synod to oversee the virtue of their elected Imperial office-holders. Gralka, an Imperial Orc, served as Conscience of the Way.

Navarr.t: Hywel Summercrow of the Navarr carried the Statement of Principle tightening the requirements for recognising Exemplars by 414 votes to 52, and Meurig Tystwarden was retained as Gatekeeper of Pride. Tockryn Nighthaven of the Navarr secured one and a half Thrones for the Phoenix Spire of Urizen.

Urizen.t: The Phoenix Spire of Urizen received one and a half Thrones from the Virtue Fund. Laelia Shatterspire of Urizen led the successful veto of the Brilliant Shore Bourse seat going to Wintermark, and Cyrus Cascade was retained as Gatekeeper of Courage. Linden of Endsmeet and Sejanus Shatterspire received visions of their past lives.

Varushka.t: Olga of Miekarova was recognised as an Exemplar of Vigilance by a Greater Majority, on a judgement raised by Irada-Catchie Bandsyna of Varushka. Petra of Varushka held the post of Cardinal of Vigilance.

Wintermark.t: The Synod vetoed the Senate's assignment of the Brilliant Shore Bourse resource to Wintermark, and a bid to recognise Horsa Monster-slayer as an Exemplar of Courage failed to reach a Greater Majority. Ingar Saker and Horsa Tyrshalt received visions of their past lives.

377YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 377YE the Synod appointed new Cardinals of Prosperity, Courage, Loyalty and Pride, vetoed the Senate's assignment of the Brilliant Shore Bourse seat to Wintermark, and tightened the rules for recognising Exemplars. It also recognised Olga of Miekarova as an Exemplar of Vigilance and rewarded four causes from the Virtue Fund.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: Mentioned in passing: the page names Olga of Miekarova, recognised as an Exemplar of Vigilance, but says nothing about Srodkoja itself.

Miekarova.t: Olga of Miekarova was recognised by the Assembly of Vigilance as an Exemplar of Vigilance, bringing Synod recognition to one of the territory's own people.

377YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: On Friday the Conclave added the Cuckoo's Egg ritual, which lets non-citizens pass through the Sentinel Gate, to Imperial Lore and appointed Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage from eight candidates. On Saturday Evander Slack and Alex Lansdale of Bregasland were declared sorcerers, a Vallorn ritual was interdicted and Concordia became Conclave Liaison to the Senate. On Sunday a declaration of enmity against Carolinos Kade failed and drake's eggs were interdicted. Approved gambits funded war magic, including a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Karsk, Winter's Ghosts on Reikos and battlefield healing against the Druj in the Barrens. Others funded scrying into the heart of Bas Celik and gifts to appease Kimus.

Dawn.t: Mentioned in passing: the Archmage of Spring had approved funding to cast Shadowed Glass of Sung to investigate the Spring Herald in Dawn.

Druj.t: The Conclave directed magic against the Druj. It funded Winter's Ghosts on Druj-held Reikos and battlefield healing for Imperial forces engaging the Druj in the Barrens.

Thule.t: The Archmage of Spring sought help with a plan to turn the forces of Llofir against the Thule rather than the Empire. The Conclave also approved raising a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Thule-held Karsk.

377YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: Across three Conclave sessions at the 377YE Winter Solstice, Imperial magicians appointed Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage and Concordia as Conclave Liaison to the Senate. They added the Cuckoo's Egg ritual to Imperial Lore, interdicted a Vallorn ritual and drake's eggs, declared two sorcerers and approved numerous ritual gambits, many in support of the war effort.

Karsk.t: The Archmage of Summer won Conclave approval to raise a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Karsk, then held by the Thule.

Reikos.t: The Archmage of Autumn received 20 mana to perform Winter's Ghosts on Druj-held Reikos.

The Barrens.t: The Archmage of Night received mana to provide battlefield healing for the Sunday engagement against the Druj in the Barrens.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The Highborn invited all citizens to a candlelit procession remembering the fallen, followed by the Day of Rebirth. The League revived the Masquerade of the Reaper, with masks, competitions, a parade with a burning effigy and a grand party. A delegation from the Chambers of Issyk in Axos docked at Crown Quay in Necropolis and travelled to Anvil seeking parley and trade. The Magistrates stressed that the Axou were protected by Imperial law. Astronomancers foresaw a conjunction of the Three Sisters, last seen before Empress Giselle's death and the final retreat from Holberg, marking a winter of blood-ties and sorrow. The mercenary Iron Raptors, under Master Aryton Scalmere, offered dangerous contracts.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but the page recalls the final Imperial retreat from Holberg, a territory they held at the time.

Highguard.t: The Highborn invited citizens of every nation to their camp for the Day of the Dead, a procession and stories honouring the fallen, followed by the Day of Rebirth. Escon, the Highborn egregore, was named as the one to answer questions about the tradition.

The League.t: The League revived the Masquerade of the Reaper, with masks, Bridge Fighting, the Hunt of Ambition, a cartas' remembrance and a parade with a burning effigy. A grand party in the League plaza followed.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: the starwatchers of Void in Volodmartz were among those who agreed that a conjunction of the Three Sisters was coming.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: Ahead of the 377YE Winter Solstice, a set of early, short Winds of Fortune announced the Highborn Day of the Dead and the League's Masquerade of the Reaper. They also heralded an Axou trade delegation, a rare conjunction of the Three Sisters and the return of the Iron Raptors to Anvil.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the last major conjunction of the Three Sisters was recalled as occurring shortly before the final retreat from Holberg.

Necropolis.t: The crimson-sailed ship of the Axou delegation from the Chambers of Issyk docked at Crown Quay in Necropolis. The delegation then travelled overland to Anvil under a scarlet flag.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: the starwatchers of Void in snow-dusted Volodmartz confirmed the coming conjunction of the Three Sisters.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Imperial forces made progress in Holberg and Karsk, where the retreating Thule salted the earth. The Summer Storm drove the last Thule out of Skarsind into Otkodov, leaving devastation and restless dead behind. In Casinea and Bastion, Dawnish, Highborn and Navarr armies prepared to strike east into Druj-held lands. The ceasefire with the Jotun held in the west despite raiding by hot-heads on both sides. Rumours spoke of Lasambrian orcs moving north into Liathaven and of Druj slipping into eastern Therunin. In Segura the Red Wind Corsairs were slowly pushed back while the Lasambrians rose. In northern Hercynia, Harak the Red mustered Thulish auxiliaries and bandits for an unknown purpose.

Druj.t: The Druj were being driven back in Holberg, while their territories around Haros Water and Broken Ridge faced an imminent Imperial offensive. A Druj force out of High Chalcis was rumoured to be slipping into Therunin.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies gathered in Casinea and Bastion alongside Dawnish and Navarr forces, ready to drive east and reclaim the lands stolen from the Highborn.

Jotun.t: The ceasefire between the Jotun and the Empire held, with the borders observed by both sides' generals despite raids by enthusiasts on each side.

Navarr.t: Navarr armies stood ready to strike east against the Druj, but the weakened Navarr in Liathaven faced Lasambrian orcs moving north. Eastern Therunin was threatened by Druj incursions.

Thule.t: The Thule fell back in Karsk, salting the earth as they went, and fled Skarsind into Otkodov to regroup. Thulish auxiliaries also gathered under Harak the Red in Hercynia's Glen of Shadows.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: the passes of Urizen's Morrow are described as eastern Therunin's precarious connection to the Empire.

Wintermark.t: Skarsind was freed from Thule occupation by the Summer Storm, though the returning Winterfolk found devastation and restless dead. The shield of Wintermark also helped push the Thule back in Karsk.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: At the Winter Solstice of 377YE, Imperial armies pressed the Thule back in Karsk, drove the Druj back in Holberg and freed Skarsind, while new threats gathered on several borders. These included Lasambrian orcs, Druj raiders and Harak the Red's forces in Hercynia.

Hercynia/The Glen of Shadows.t: The isolated orcs of the Glen of Shadows lit their war beacons and gathered under Harak the Red's banners, but made no move north or south.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: Rumours spoke of a well-armed mob of Lasambrian orcs moving north towards Beacon Point.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: Western Scout was rumoured to be a target for Lasambrian orcs moving north to exploit Navarr weakness.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: Unseen voices whispering "Soon" were heard through the ghost-haunted glades of Broken Ridge as Imperial armies prepared to strike.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: Winter winds howled across the walls of Haros Water while Imperial forces readied to sweep eastward.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: Druj scouts were rumoured to be sneaking through the marshes of Lower Tarn, bringing fire and poison.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: A Druj force out of High Chalcis was rumoured to be slinking over the borders into Peakedge Song.

Bastion.t: Imperial forces massed in Bastion, ready to sweep east and reclaim Highborn lands from the Druj.

Casinea.t: Dawnish, Highborn and Navarr armies stood ready in Casinea to drive a spear into the heart of the Druj.

Hercynia.t: In northern Hercynia, the isolated orcs of the Glen of Shadows lit their war beacons and gathered under Harak the Red for an unknown purpose.

Holberg.t: The tide turned in Holberg as Imperial forces drove the Druj back, and its people could once again stand on their walls.

Karsk.t: The Thule fell back in Karsk before Marcher, Wintermark and Varushkan armies, salting the earth wherever they could.

Liathaven.t: A ceasefire with the Jotun held in Liathaven, but Lasambrian orcs were rumoured to be moving north to exploit the weakness of the last Navarr there.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the passes of Morrow are described as eastern Therunin's precarious link to the rest of the Empire.

Otkodov.t: The Thule armies driven out of Skarsind retreated across the mountains into Otkodov to lick their wounds and prepare their next assault.

Reikos.t: Druj-held Reikos lay in the path of the Imperial armies massing to the west, and whispers of "Soon" were heard at Haros Water and Broken Ridge.

Segura.t: The Red Wind Corsairs were slowly being pushed back in Segura, while the Freeborn army there barely held against two armies as the Lasambrian Hills grew stronger.

Skarsind.t: The last Thule forces were driven from Skarsind by the Summer Storm, but the returning Winterfolk found devastation, a lingering taint and restless dead.

Therunin.t: Eastern Therunin, connected to the Empire only by the passes of Morrow, faced rumours of Druj raiders crossing into Peakedge Song and creeping through the Tarn.

379YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: Ten territories were due to appoint senators, each by its own national custom, from Dawn's Tourney for Astolat to the largest purse for Madruga. Skarsind was to elect the first Imperial Orc senator. Generals were due for seven armies and an admiral for the Brass Coast navy, chosen unanimously by national senators or else by the Senate. The orc tradition of choosing generals by contest in the fighting pit was expected to face scrutiny. The Synod was to fill Cardinals of the Way and Prosperity, the Conscience of the Senate, the High Exorcist and the Voice of Barbs. The Bourse had five weirwood seats at auction, the Senate was to decide the Vigilant Swan's allocation, and several national ministries were open.

Dawn.t: Dawnish nobles whose houses held no Senate seat could compete in the Tourney for Astolat's seat, and the generalship of the Hounds of Glory was also to be filled.

Highguard.t: Chapters in Necropolis could put forward candidates for the Highborn senator, chosen by citizens with congregations.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were to elect their first ever senator, for Skarsind, and the Winter Sun needed a general, though the custom of choosing generals in the fighting pit was expected to come under scrutiny now the orcs had a senator.

Navarr.t: The Navarr were to elect a senator for Hercynia in an open-air vote, appoint the Voice of Barbs through their national assembly, and choose the holder of the Thimble from among herb garden holders.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn dhomiro could bid for the right to appoint Madruga's senator, an admiral was needed for the Freeborn navy, and fleet captains were to choose the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills.

The League.t: Temeschwari business owners were to back candidates for their senator, and the Towerjacks needed a general.

The Marches.t: Bregasland farm owners were to align with stewards to name their senator, the Strong Reeds needed a general, and Marcher farmers could vote for the Bailiff of the Grand Market.

Urizen.t: Zenith's spires could put up candidates for senator, voted on by the territory's ritual magicians, while Urizen mana site owners were to choose the Provost of the Halls of Knowledge.

Varushka.t: Any Varushkan could stand for Miekarova's seat, with the wise ones judging the wisest candidate, and the Army of the Golden Axe needed a general.

Wintermark.t: Any Wintermark citizen could stand for Kallavesa's seat, decided by the Kallavesi alone, and the Green Shield Army needed a general.

379YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: The page set out the Imperial titles up for election or appointment at the 379YE Winter Solstice, including ten Senate seats (among them the first Imperial Orc senator for Skarsind), seven Military Council posts, several Synod and Conclave titles, and a number of Bourse seats.

Astolat.t: Astolat's senator was to be decided by a Tourney open to nobles whose houses did not already hold a Senate seat.

Bregasland.t: Marchers owning farms in Bregasland were to align with stewards to compete for the right to name the territory's senator.

Hercynia.t: Any Navarr could stand for Hercynia's seat, but only those with resources in Hercynia could vote in the open-air election.

Kahraman.t: The Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills, chosen by Freeborn fleet captains, would take responsibility for looking after Kahraman along with the right to buy trade goods.

Kallavesa.t: Only the Kallavesi were to have a say in who would represent their marshy territory in the Senate.

Madruga.t: The Freeborn dhomiro who put in the largest purse would claim the right to appoint Madruga's senator.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's senator was to be the candidate the wise ones judged the wisest.

Necropolis.t: Chapters in Necropolis could each put forward a candidate for senator, with Highborn citizens holding congregations selecting the best.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind was to elect the first Imperial Orc senator at this Solstice.

Temeschwar.t: Citizens running businesses in Temeschwar were to throw their weight behind their favoured candidate for senator.

Zenith.t: Each spire in Zenith could put forward a candidate, with the territory's ritual magicians voting on who would represent them.

386YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.d: The Jotun had seized Southmoor, Greensward, Ore Hills and Chalkdowns and reinstated Jarl Haakon. The Marcher Tusks and Highguard's Granite Pillar stood in defence while Highborn, Marcher, Orc, Dawnish, League and Wintermark armies attacked. The Towerjacks, Citadel Guard and Northern Eagle hurried to Redoubt amid rumours of a Children of Wrecks attack. Imperial forces withdrew from the Brass Coast and Ayereed, leaving the Winter Sun alone in Mareave. In Therunin, Navarr, Varushkan and Dawnish armies struck at the Druj after a costly battle to save Feverwater Steading. General Archavion Wolfborne ordered the Gryphon's Pride to seize the Fangs mine from the Rahvin. Only the Wolves of War, Black Thorns and Iron Helms earned the guerdon.

Dawn.t: The Eastern Sky joined the Mournwold offensive and the Golden Sun kept up its grinding advance in Therunin. General Archavion Wolfborne set the Gryphon's Pride to seize the Fangs from the Rahvin, an act that will bring the full force of the law on him and his captains.

Druj.t: Having failed to destroy Feverwater Steading or rouse the Sweetglades vallorn, the Druj in Therunin faced attacks from four Imperial armies. The Gryphon's Pride's strike on the Rahvin was feared to wreck any hope of peace with other Druj slaves.

Grendel.t: The Empire's probing strike into Ayereed fell back, leaving only the Winter Sun in Mareave. A great Grendel force remained camped on the Madruga coast and Commander Gallum Fiersach still held Mora's Rock in Feroz.

Highguard.t: All three Highborn armies marched on the Mournwold in a crusade invoking Synod judgement 117. The Granite Pillar held a strategic defence while the Seventh Wave force-marched from Ayereed and the Valiant Pegasus advanced on Southmoor.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Autumn Hammers and Summer Storm made a steady conquest against the Jotun in the Mournwold. The Winter Sun fell back to give ground in Mareave and was its only defender against the Grendel.

Jotun.t: Tens of thousands of Jotun held four Mournwold regions under Jarl Haakon and now faced a dozen Imperial armies. It was uncertain whether they would stand, sweep into Bregasland or strike toward Tassato.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns made a balanced attack in Therunin and earned the guerdon, while Isaella's Dance struck through the Barrens into Eastring with poison thorns. The Quiet Step, under Vesna Borkovna Prochnost, mounted a solid defence of Miaren.

The Brass Coast.t: With Feroz freed, the Burning Falcon and Fire of the South left for a desperate reinforcement of Astolat and the Red Wind Corsairs rested in Tassato. That left no Imperial armies on the uncertain Brass Coast.

The League.t: The Towerjacks dug in at Redoubt, their orders mourning the fall of General Barossa. The Wolves of War made a balanced attack on the Mournwold and earned the guerdon.

The Marches.t: The Tusks stood in strategic defence of the Mournwold while the Bounders and Drakes attacked the Jotun. The Strong Reeds lay low in Bregasland and were the only army standing there against the Jotun.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard marched from Morrow to a solid defence of Redoubt, reinforced by League and Varushkan armies against a rumoured Wrecker attack. Meanwhile the Golden Axe came to Zenith.

Varushka.t: In his last orders, General Belakov sent the Golden Axe to give ground in Zenith. The Iron Helms, quickened with cold-meat magic, attacked the Druj in Therunin for the guerdon, and the Northern Eagle harried foes in Redoubt.

Wintermark.t: The Narwhal's Spear sought the foe in the Mournwold while the Green Shield billeted in Upwold. The Bloodcloaks tended the fallen and the Fist of the Mountains read the signs, both in Tassato.

386YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial generals issued their orders, sending a dozen armies against the Jotun in the Mournwold, three to defend Redoubt and four against the Druj in Therunin. The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to attack the Rahvin of the Barrens despite the Senate's protection of those orcs.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: Chalkdowns was among the regions seized by the Jotun, where the Imperial counter-offensive was now directed.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Greensward lay under Jotun control after their seizure of the Mourn, facing the Imperial armies massing against them.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Though held by the Jotun, the Ore Hills saw a victory by Imperial heroes that inspired the people of the Mourn to rise.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Jotun-held Southmoor was the target of the Seventh Wave, Valiant Pegasus and Bounders as they sought to liberate it.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Isaella's Dance was ordered to strike into Eastring through the Barrens with poison thorns against the Druj.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Imperial heroes prevented the Druj from rousing the Sweetglades vallorn, though Spring corruption still crept across the territory.

Astolat.t: The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South marched here in desperate reinforcement, while Isaella's Dance left Astolat for Therunin.

Ayereed.t: The Empire's probing strike fell back from Ayereed, with the Seventh Wave, Winter Sun and Golden Axe all departing.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds lay low here as the only army facing the Jotun, whose enchanted castle rose over Gravenrock, and a Jotun sweep into the territory was feared.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar marched from Casinea to the Mournwold.

Feroz.t: Feroz was declared freed and the Imperial armies there departed, but Commander Gallum Fiersach still held the fort of Mora's Rock.

Madruga.t: With Imperial forces withdrawn, Madruga remained split between factions, and a great Grendel force was camped on the fens that were once the Siroc Plains.

Mareave.t: The Winter Sun gave ground in Mareave as its sole defender, wary of Grendel armies following from Ayereed.

Miaren.t: The Quiet Step returned from the Mournwold to mount a solid defence of Miaren.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes, who had smashed ships on the river Meade, marched from Mitwold, and the Autumn Hammers passed through it to the Mournwold.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Citadel Guard marched from Morrow to defend Redoubt.

Mournwold.t: With the Jotun holding four regions, a dozen Imperial armies converged on the Mournwold, the Tusks and Granite Pillar defending while the rest attacked.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Axe's general listed Ossium among the territories his army had fought in.

Redoubt.t: Storm-wracked Redoubt was reinforced by the Towerjacks, Citadel Guard and Northern Eagle amid rumours of a Children of Wrecks attack.

Tassato.t: The Red Wind Corsairs, Bloodcloaks and Fist of the Mountains recuperated in Tassato, which was thought vulnerable to a Jotun strike.

The Barrens.t: The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to seize the Fangs mine from the Rahvin, whom the Senate had declared protected foreigners, and Isaella's Dance passed through on its way to Therunin.

Therunin.t: After a costly battle to save Feverwater Steading, the Golden Sun, Black Thorns, Isaella's Dance and Iron Helms struck at the Druj amid spreading vallorn corruption.

Upwold.t: The Green Shield billeted in Upwold while the Summer Storm left for the Mournwold.

Zenith.t: The Golden Axe moved to Zenith to give ground, rest and celebrate under its departing general.

386YE Spring Equinox Conclave sessions.d: Raewyn Farkas became Hand of the Healers, Eliina Lailasdottir Archmage of Night, Raficci Vicente Barossa Imperial War Mage and Bella Vicente d'Apulian Arcane Envoy. Skywise Gralka retained Archmage of Day, and a declaration of sorcery against them failed. Concords accepted Wise Rangara's aid for the Bleak Tower and the Tower of the Fall. The Conclave accepted Roshanwe's Netweaver's Eye and Estavus's survey of three Bourse seats, and endowed the Westmere Anvil to Estavus. The Shuttered Lantern, Unfettered Mind and Golden Pyramid were sent to investigate Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, Temeschwar's rats and Mareave respectively. Chastise the Foolish was licensed and Surcease of Sorrow entered Imperial Lore. Assay the Barrens and Seek for Relics failed.

Grendel.t: The Conclave endorsed Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea across the Bay of Catazar, explicitly as a means to fight the Grendel navies, and warned locals to take precautions.

Imperial Orcs.t: Following successful prospecting in Skarsind, the Golden Pyramid was sent on a similar expedition to the Imperial-controlled regions of Mareave, described as Imperial Orc territory, to discover what resources could be found.

Navarr.t: Surcease of Sorrow was entered into Imperial Lore to preserve it as a legacy for Navarr to use until their founders' dance is complete, with Morwenna Witheredrose providing the 10 thrones.

The League.t: The Order of the Unfettered Mind was sent, at a cost of 20 crystal mana, to investigate a rat problem plaguing the League territory of Temeschwar.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Lore ritual Chastise the Foolish was licensed and is no longer interdicted, while concords committed the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall to protect Urizen from the creatures of Agramant and the Bleak Tower's custodian to protect the herb gardens of Morrow, both with Wise Rangara's aid.

386YE Spring Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox the Conclave, drawing on a font of 190 mana, appointed several titles, approved expeditions and investigations, accepted offers from eternals, licensed an interdicted Urizen ritual and endorsed Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea against the Grendel navies.

Mareave.t: The Golden Pyramid was dispatched, at a cost of 20 crystal mana, to explore the Imperial-controlled regions of Mareave and discover what resources can be found there.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the earlier successful prospecting in Skarsind is cited as the reason for sending the Golden Pyramid to Mareave.

Temeschwar.t: The Unfettered Mind was sent to investigate peculiar events in Temeschwar involving a plague of rats.

387YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly rejected removing the Doctrine of the Creator (120-952). Viviane Barossa's mandate warning against malign spiritual presences defeated Fintan Nighthaven's rival call to explore them. Corey Wayfarer's mandate to put destroying the vallorn above all else failed. A statement urging the Empire to defeat the Druj before turning on the vallorn passed overwhelmingly. The Synod pledged not to preach to the Thule while Kindra Surefoot's treaty stands. General Rhisiart Dancewalker of the Black Thorns was revoked. Alberto Acciai and Eleanor Novarion were recognised as exemplars of Loyalty and Pride. The Council of Nine set the Silent Bell to investigate the Falconer's cult of the Claw.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly refused to give up a Dawnish fifth army to win the Thule's peace terms (354-0). It praised Dame Katelyn Cordraco, condemned mass spells in tourneys, debated the Earl of the Groves, and narrowly backed returning goods taken from the Rahvin.

Druj.t: The Synod backed defeating the Druj before turning on the vallorn. The Navarr Assembly called for resistance and sabotage against Druj occupation in Therunin, and Druj who fled into Dark Ranging were marked for hunting.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly charged its newly raised fourth army to bring salvation, not hatred. It enacted a mandate of peerless kinship to support other nations, rejected a call to crusade until the last war is won, and warned its Necropolis chapters against cults of the Wastewalker.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc Assembly challenged the Synod to prove that exorcising orc ghosts does not destroy their one chance to cross the Abyss. It warned of an old terror rising in the Bay of Catazar and named Sunstorm Nirrin for recognition by all Imperial Orcs.

Jotun.t: The Marcher Assembly vowed to fight on with General Stanley to drive the Jotun from the Mourn. It praised the Marcher orcs who took up arms against the Jotun.

Navarr.t: Navarr's assembly urged resistance in Therunin, championed Thornsong House and potioncraft, and rallied the nation behind the City of Dreams in Seren. Its general, Rhisiart Dancewalker of the Black Thorns, was revoked by the General Assembly over losses in Therunin.

The League.t: The League Assembly backed building trading posts across Temeschwar and urged citizens of Sarvos and Apulian to keep lights burning after the last lighthouse on the Bay of Catazar fell. It also rewarded Gabrieli di Tassato and Novella di Sarvos.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly pledged to keep fighting until the Mourn is free and honoured the Marcher orcs who fought the Jotun. It recognised Navarr's loyalty and enacted a mandate letting Marcher fleets support the Red Wind Corsairs.

Thule.t: The General Assembly pledged not to preach to the Thule while Ambassador Kindra Surefoot's treaty stands. Dawn rejected the Thule's latest demand for Imperial land, calling it blackmail.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Assembly praised the Ashen Flame coven's defence of Redoubt and supported saving Solen's Doubt's library as the dam rises. It warned Redoubt's coastal people of a winter eternal and asked the Citadel Guard to bring salvation rather than curses to Sarangrave.

Varushka.t: Varushka's assembly backed its new army and enacted wards to protect the Apstrus dam from restless spirits. It set the Kestov a penance to help rebuild Ossium, warned of Webwood creatures on Ossium's borders, and condemned idolatrous Bone Serpent shrines.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's assembly backed a fane to Sadogua to protect Kallavesa and added Kaisa Denmother to the Chronicle of Heroism. It enacted a mandate shielding Wintermark from mandates without a greater majority, and warned against the cult of the Claw and two Blood on Snow cultists fleeing to Hahnmark.

387YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 191 judgements. Dominant themes were the false virtues, the wars against the Druj and the vallorn, preaching in Faraden and Asavea, and the hallowing of the seven coronation bells.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Dark Ranging was named as the refuge of Druj who fled there with heralds of Yaw'nagrah, and Imperial captains were urged to search it.

Casinea/Woodwych.t: Mentioned in passing: Destin of the Woodwych Harts raised a Vigilance judgement supporting the pilgrimage of the hallowed coronation bells.

Brocéliande.t: The Navarr Assembly urged military captains reinforcing the Broch to hunt down the Druj who fled into Brocéliande, aided by heralds of Yaw'nagrah.

Casinea.t: Highguard's fourth army was being raised in Casinea, and the Highborn Assembly charged it to bring salvation rather than mere conquest.

Miaren.t: The Navarr Assembly urged the nation to finish the City of Dreams in Seren before the great work lapses, recalling the Cold Sun's destruction of Rhonwen's Falls.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: donations to the Synod's Virtue Fund were received at the counting house of Reikos.

Sarangrave.t: The Ambition Assembly urged help for Sarangrave's oppressed septs to explore the Way. The Urizen Assembly asked the Military Council to summon Irra Hara's Wooden Fastness there instead of targeting curses through the Citadel Guard.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: donations to the Synod's Virtue Fund were received at the counting house of Semmerholm.

Tassato.t: The League Assembly narrowly called on Tassato's citizens to recognise Gabrieli di Tassato as rightful challenger to Gabriel Barossa's legacy. Donations to the Virtue Fund were also received at Tassato's counting house.

Upwold.t: Two Blood on Snow cultists behind a recent attack in Upwold were reported fleeing north to Hahnmark. Upwold's senator was praised for voting against road tolls.

387YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad became Voice of the Horizons, Casimir Pakkanovic Mislova became Imperial Magus, Bloodcrow Arora became Archmage of Winter and Vellenka Vanyanova became Shadowed Torchbearer. The Rod and Shield and Golden Pyramid were sent to the Commonwealth, the Silver Chalice to Lantir, and the Celestial Arch, Sevenfold Path and Shuttered Lantern to Jarm. The Conclave asked the Senate for an Advisor on the Cold Sun and added Viridian's Wildfire Emberstrike to Imperial lore. It declined the Apex Hyperion's offers for the Silver Flame and accepted the Monarchs of the Vast's Gift of Light. The Sevenfold Path received 150 mana crystals for its Grand Lodge.

Druj.t: A Rod and Shield concord declaring the Druj to be collapsing and committing Conclave to averting the doom of the Dying Scorpion above all others failed.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: a Golden Pyramid concord thanking the heralds active in Mareave contrasted the Empire with the Grendel, who it said had not seen Mareave's potential.

The League.t: Conclave condemned the idea of giving Imperial lore to the Silver Flame, the foreigners who control Cinion in the League territory of Spiral.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Thule warlocks provided twenty mana to the Conclave font as part of their treaty obligations with the Empire.

Urizen.t: An endorsement to cast Regrow the Land's Heart on the Sarangrave in Urizen, using the power Llofir had offered, failed.

387YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice the Conclave, drawing on a font of 364 mana, elected new title-holders and sent several orders to oppose the Cold Sun in the Commonwealth and the Principalities of Jarm. It also condemned sharing Imperial lore with the Silver Flame and declined commitments regarding the Druj and the Sarangrave.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Silver Flame's request for Imperial lore was formally condemned by Conclave. A neutral alignment with Sinokenon declined the offers made for the Tribunal of the Silver Flame, citing constitutional freedoms.

Mareave.t: Conclave thanked the heralds of the City of Gold and Lead and the City of Bar and Bond for their intervention during the Mareave campaign. The Golden Pyramid pledged to continue investing there.

Spiral.t: Conclave condemned disseminating Imperial lore to the Silver Flame, who hold Cinion within Spiral, and rejected the Apex Hyperion's offers made on that fledgling nation's behalf.

387YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1519 thrones and 6 crowns. The Senate abrogated the Grendel embassy in Redoubt, ejecting its staff, and removed embassy upkeep and ministry access in exchange for gifts. It gave 90 thrones to Rhydian de Rondell of Dawn to stop Druj ritualists threatening to loose 25,000 vallornspawn on Therunin. It also created the Broker of Thorns and Stoat of the Sun, switched Thule's food supply from the Marches to Dawn, and renamed Mount Polus 'Kespoena's Reach'. Commissions included the Beacon of Sermersuaq, the rebuilt Great Library of Ankarien, a spy network in Tsirku and a wayhouse in Utterlund. Appraisals were sent to Volodmartz and Nesustak Forest.

Dawn.t: Rhydian de Rondell of Dawn received 90 thrones to defeat Druj ritualists in Therunin, Dawn replaced the Marches as Thule's food supplier, and Weirwater gained the Ozren Orzel tomb and the Story Garden, which offers potions to virtuous Dawnish citizens.

Druj.t: Senate funds were sent to defeat Druj ritualists in Therunin, whose working threatened to unleash 25,000 vallornspawn, and an appraisal was sought into the rebels of Nesustak Forest in Druj-held Sarangrave.

Grendel.t: The Grendel embassy in Redoubt was abrogated and its staff forcibly ejected, although the title of Ambassador to the Grendel was kept.

Highguard.t: Highborn citizens Melchior of Balthazar's Vineyard and Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll became Ambassadors to Beoraidh and Jarm, and Highguard invited the Commonwealth's scholars to appraise closer military, trade and philosophical ties.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Sorrowful Tunnels were allocated as an Imperial Orc national title, and the Legion Rookery was turned into an edifice that halves the cost of extra mithril for the tunnels' miners.

Jotun.t: The Minister of Historical Research commissioned research into the Dance of Blood and its consequences for relations between the Navarr and the Jotun.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained the Broker of Thorns bourse seat in the Barrens through an accord with the Great Forest Orcs, and Arthur Bannerman of Navarr was appointed Captain of the Senate Guard. Research was also ordered into Dewyn High Thorn Path and the Dance of Blood.

The League.t: The League gave up the Tassatan Hills ilium mine, with 250 thrones repaid to Holberg's senator, and built the Circo del Topo in Temeschwar and a great lighthouse in Kallavesa, though the Rat Garden commission failed.

Thule.t: The nation feeding the Thule was switched from the Marches to Dawn, changing the limits on Imperial forces in Otkodov, and the election of an Ambassador to Otkodov was deferred to Spring 388YE.

Urizen.t: Urizeni senators expelled the Grendel embassy from Redoubt, rebuilt the Great Library of Ankarien, renamed Mount Polus 'Kespoena's Reach' and commissioned several works in Spiral and Zenith. Lightstone trade also brought extra coin to Morrow and Redoubt.

Varushka.t: Mine owners in Volodmartz and Miekarova each gained 36 extra rings a season through the Light Market, an appraisal was sent to restore prosperity to Volodmartz, and Vojsuli Cherenkov was ratified as General of the Golden Axe.

Wintermark.t: The final set of Wintermark's Beacons was commissioned in Sealtoq, Sermersuaq, drawing on a boon from Cathan Canae, completing the network.

387YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 387YE the Imperial Senate passed a broad slate of motions, including the expulsion of the Grendel embassy from Redoubt, the relinquishing of the Tassatan Hills mine, numerous self-funded commissions, and several appointments of ambassadors and generals.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: A self-funded wayhouse named The Splintered House was built in Utterlund.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Senate sent Naomi of Virtue's Rest to appraise solutions to the rebels holding out in Nesustak Forest.

Holberg.t: Holberg's senator received 250 thrones to repay the Tassatan Hills investors, a wayhouse was built in Utterlund, and a citizen donated 28 thrones towards the upkeep of Holberg's Walls.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's mine owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from the Light Market, and its senator seconded the appraisal of Volodmartz's prosperity.

Morrow.t: Morrow's business owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from lightstone sold to Varushka, and the Three Watchers were put forward for re-examination in light of new fortification techniques.

Otkodov.t: Supplies for the Thule in Otkodov will now come from Dawn rather than the Marches, and an Ambassador to Otkodov is to be elected at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Redoubt.t: The Grendel embassy in Redoubt was shut and its staff expelled, while Redoubt's business owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from the lightstone trade.

Sarangrave.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest was sent to appraise solutions to the rebels of Nesustak Forest, with results due before the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Tsirku.t: The Imperial Spymaster commissioned an Imperial spy network in Tsirku.

Volodmartz.t: Graciana i Lopez i Guerra was sent to find ways to restore prosperity to the ruins left by the Cold Sun, and Volodmartz's mine owners will receive 36 extra rings each season.

388YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.d: Thirty-two armies received orders. In the Salt Flats, the Towerjacks sought to be first through the gates of Iskrid, the Druj capital, and the Northern Eagle moved to secure Beladrarsh. In Reinos, Brass Coast, League, Imperial Orc, Navarr and Wintermark armies attacked the Jotun, with the Red Wind Corsairs raiding Ribeira. In Mareave, seven armies stood against the Grendel, led by the Eastern Sky calling on the Mistress of Blizzards. In Bregasland, Marcher armies stood shoulder to shoulder, supported by healers and the Golden Sun's heroic stand. Elsewhere, the Granite Pillar defended Zenith, the Black Thorns reinforced Astolat and the Drakes stayed in Madruga. Only the Seventh Wave and Golden Axe offered supporting units a share of the Guerdon.

Dawn.t: Dawn split its four armies: the Eastern Sky defended Mareave under its new general Olivia Lucentia, and the Golden Sun made a heroic stand in Bregasland. The Gryphon's Pride and Lions of Adelmar pressed the Druj in the Salt Flats, the Lions with the aim of letting Dawn see the sea again.

Druj.t: Nine Imperial armies descended on the Druj-held Salt Flats of Sanath. They included overwhelming assaults aimed at Iskrid and a Varushkan push to end the Skinweavers' rule in Beladrarsh.

Grendel.t: Seven Imperial armies gathered in Mareave to meet an expected Grendel invasion, with Orc generals vowing to bleed the Grendel for every inch they tried to claim.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar held Zenith and the Pilgrim's Defiance protected innocents in the Salt Flats. The Seventh Wave defended Mareave with a share of the Guerdon, and the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Bregasland.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Summer Storm and Winter Sun defended the Orc homeland of Mareave against the Grendel, the latter with hit-and-run tactics. The Autumn Hammers marched through Kahraman to conquer Jotun land in Reinos.

Jotun.t: Seven Imperial armies attacked Reinos, including a Brass Coast raid on Ribeira, while six armies held Bregasland against Jotun counterattack.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns withdrew to reinforce Astolat, leaving Therunin to wait, and the Quiet Step joined the overwhelming assault on the Salt Flats. The Star Forged fought alongside Wintermark's Narwhal's Spear in Reinos.

The Brass Coast.t: Aracelis i Erigo handed the Burning Falcon to Shivana i Erigo for a triumphant charge into Reinos, and the Red Wind Corsairs raided Ribeira's wagons. The Fire of the South stood in defence of the Unshackled in Mareave.

The League.t: The Sparrows Reckoning sought conquest in Reinos and the Towerjacks aimed to be first through the gates of Iskrid in the Salt Flats. The Wolves of War defended Mareave.

The Marches.t: The Bounders, Strong Reeds and Tusks stood shoulder to shoulder to hold Bregasland against the Jotun. The Drakes remained in Madruga while their general urged them to come home.

Urizen.t: The Argent Sword marched from Zenith to defend Mareave. The Citadel Guard called down Winter's Mantle on the Druj in the Salt Flats.

Varushka.t: All three Varushkan armies struck the Salt Flats: the Boyar's Hasta plundered, seeking a black lotus, and the Golden Axe joined the overwhelming assault with a share of the Guerdon. The Northern Eagle moved to secure Beladrarsh.

Wintermark.t: The Bloodcloaks tended the fallen in Bregasland. The Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear fought with honour in Reinos, the latter partnering Navarr's Star Forged.

388YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Imperial generals sent nine armies to assault the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath and seven to attack the Jotun in Reinos. They also massed seven armies to defend Mareave against an expected Grendel invasion and kept six holding Bregasland.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The Summer Storm's general warned that the Grendel were trying to get into Icarion and marched back to defend it.

Reinos/Ribeira.t: The Red Wind Corsairs targeted Ribeira's Jotun wagon raiders, and the Sparrows Reckoning named Ribeira as a goal of its conquest.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Beladrarsh.t: Varushka's Northern Eagle moved to secure Beladrarsh and end the rule of its Skinweavers.

Astolat.t: Navarr's Black Thorns marched from the Salt Flats to give Astolat a desperate reinforcement.

Bregasland.t: Six armies held Bregasland: three Marcher armies shoulder to shoulder, Dawn's Golden Sun in a heroic stand, and Highguard's Valiant Pegasus and Wintermark's Bloodcloaks tending the fallen.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: Aracelis i Erigo recalled the Burning Falcon claiming Feroz from Rahab in a single season.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks' general recalled the long march since they retook their homes in Holberg.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Autumn Hammers marched south through Kahraman on their way to Reinos.

Madruga.t: The Marcher army the Drakes remained in Madruga, standing shoulder to shoulder there, while the Star Forged left Madruga for Reinos.

Mareave.t: Seven armies defended Mareave against the expected Grendel invasion: five in solid defence, the Winter Sun with hit-and-run tactics and the Eastern Sky embracing the storm.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar's general recalled fighting from the Mournwold, and the Bounders invoked John of the Mourn.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta marched from Ossium to plunder the Salt Flats.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Seventh Wave's general urged the army to remember the refugees of Reikos.

Reinos.t: Seven armies attacked Jotun-held Reinos, combining steady conquest, a triumphant charge, a daring raid and Wintermark fighting with honour.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Nine armies converged on the Salt Flats: overwhelming assaults aimed at Iskrid, Dawnish pushes, plunder, Winter's Mantle, protection of innocents and an attempt to secure Beladrarsh.

Sarangrave.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar's general recalled fighting as far east as the Sarangrave.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky's previous general is referred to as the Star of Semmerholm.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Aracelis i Erigo recalled the Burning Falcon running across the ice of Sermersuaq.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Axe marched from Therunin, and the Black Thorns' general said Therunin would wait.

Zenith.t: Highguard's Granite Pillar mounted a strategic defence of Zenith, while four other armies departed Zenith for Mareave and the Salt Flats.

388YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Skywise Rykana's change of doctrine passed 2733-54. Navarr's attempt to veto ceding the Last Battle Wayhouse in the Barrens to the Karass failed 0-112. Enacted mandates consecrated Rebellion's Ridge in the Mournwold to Pride, ended the abandoned state of two Feroz regions, sent League bravos to court the Protectorate of Morajasse, staked a Marcher claim to Liathaven and reassured the Freeborn about the Marracossan exiles. A writ to consecrate the Beacons of Sermersuaq to Vigilance was upheld. Many statements of principle were passed, including several seeking friendship with Faraden. The Assembly also issued numerous inquisitions, sanctions and appointments, and the Virtue Fund distributed rewards such as Library funds and weirwood.

Dawn.t: The Dawn Assembly named its Champions of Virtue and asked the civil service to restart the Barrens Roads appraisal, covering the Rahvin and the Great Forest Orcs but not the Karass. It also appointed Tren Meals as Reeve of Greenforest Fair and Tristan Donatien Nicholas Reynauld as Lady of the Proffered Hand.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are named as the enslavers of the Great Forest Orcs whose rescue was praised, and as former patrons of the Karass.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn Assembly thanked the Varushkan fleets and vowed to defy the Grendel threatening the Bay.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly sought military advice for a Benefactors Court at Virtue's Rest and pledged support to Great Forest Orcs settling in Reikos. It also entrusted the Relic of Rhonwen to Dagon Nighthaven and backed an effort to destroy the labyrinth spirit threatening Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Doctrine of the Final Challenge, raised by the orc exemplar Skywise Rykana, replaced the Howling Abyss, and the Imperial Orc Assembly urged its people to reject reincarnation. It also sent Firesong Galath to learn about the Jotun ancestors, while a Navarr mandate pledged to share all it could with the orcs for the Vallornguard.

Jotun.t: Judgements celebrated the Jotun retreat from Bregasland and William Guildernstern's slaying of the Summerborn champion Sigrun. A Marcher mandate stirred ambitions to take Liathaven from the Jotun, and an Imperial Orc delegation set out to study their ancestors.

Navarr.t: Navarr's veto of the Karass cession failed, and the Navarr Assembly sent Father Dagda to help the Imperial Orcs prepare for the Vallorn fight. The Courage Assembly honoured the 433 Navarr who helped free the Great Forest Orcs, and Oleander Dreamsreach became Dreamspeaker of Seren.

The Brass Coast.t: A Freeborn mandate reassured the nation about trading with the Marracossan exiles, who will be defended in Madruga if they are persecuted. The Assembly also sought the Kohan's aid against the tyrants at its borders and called Gisli the Provider to inquisition after the magics on Madruga.

The League.t: A League mandate sent bravos to woo the Protectorate of Morajasse, while a rival bid to court Leen failed. The Pride Assembly recognised Lorenzo von Temeschwar as an Exemplar of Pride, pending the General Assembly, and the League Assembly celebrated Sarvos's five sacred sites.

The Marches.t: Rebellion's Ridge was consecrated to Pride, bringing disruption to the Mourn but letting its mine owners elect the next senator, and a Marcher mandate staked a claim to Liathaven. The Marcher Assembly also honoured William Guildernstern as a folk hero and proposed teaching foot-the-ball to Tsark.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule are noted as having held the Bloodcloak for a century and as currently holding Varushkan regions.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Assembly welcomed the Proffered Hand's work with the displaced septs of Sarangrave and exalted Orson BogMyrtle, calling for old grudges with the Marches to be buried. It also called Vespasian of Tropaion and Tiberius Stormspire Cascade to inquisition.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly urged the nation to prepare for war while the Thule hold its regions, and imposed penance on Sigismund for a failed command. Its mandate to gather treasures in Tsirku was upheld but had no effect, as it lacked the greater majority Varushka requires.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark entered Nora Falcon's Light into the Chronicle of Heroes and Amberlain's oath into the Forge of Bonds, and celebrated the fearless army to be raised from the Hall of the Soturi. The Synod also upheld a writ to consecrate the Beacons of Sermersuaq, and the Assembly named new places in Tsirku.

388YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Imperial Synod raised 169 judgements, most notably replacing the Doctrine of the Howling Abyss with the Doctrine of the Final Challenge by a greater majority of the General Assembly.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Afarjasse lost the abandoned quality as a result of the Prosperity mandate encouraging investment in Feroz.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: League bravos will reach out to the Protectorate of Morajasse to try to bring it closer to the League.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Oranseri lost the abandoned quality as a result of the Prosperity mandate encouraging investment in Feroz.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Mentioned in passing: Harry the Axe of Alderly was called to inquisition over Pride, Loyalty and five wains of weirwood.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Mentioned in passing: Rebellion's Ridge was consecrated in memory of the Ore Hills Rebels.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Dawn Assembly asked that the restarted Barrens Roads appraisal include a road to the Rahvin here.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: The Dawn Assembly asked that the restarted Barrens Roads appraisal include a road to the Great Forest Orcs here.

Tsirku/Warriors' Gate.t: Claude Deeds led a band to Warriors' Gate to free the trapped ghost of the scop Theodric Mooting, a deed rewarded with ten thrones.

Bregasland.t: Amberlain P. Black's oath that the Strong Reeds will never abandon Bregasland was entered into the Forge of Bonds. William Guildernstern's victory over Sigrun in the marshes was celebrated as Marcher folklore.

Feroz.t: A Prosperity mandate lifted the abandoned quality from Afarjasse and Oranseri, but new commissions here will cost four crowns a wain in labour until no region is impoverished. The League also began reaching out to the Protectorate of Morajasse.

Kallavesa.t: The Wintermark Assembly praised the Hall of the Soturi, commissioned to host the army to be raised here, and denied rumours of cruel training. The drum of the scop Theodric Mooting was laid to rest in Kallavesa.

Liathaven.t: A Marcher mandate created an opportunity for the Marches to work towards conquering Liathaven from the Jotun once Bregasland is secure. It also raised a popular expectation that the Marchers will get first claim, though the Senate is not legally bound.

Madruga.t: The Marracossan exiles in Madruga can trade as before, and its people will resist any move against them as if it targeted their Freeborn neighbours. Magics on Madruga prompted inquisitions of Gisli the Provider and Bakar i Riqueza.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Asthore Autumngale is to face inquisition over his time as Senator for Miaren.

Mournwold.t: Rebellion's Ridge was consecrated with true liao to Pride, so personal resources in the Mourn suffer a two-rank penalty for a season, but its mine owners will elect the next senator. Hamma the Lame and Harry the Axe were also called to inquisition.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Bronimir, Senator for Ossium, was issued a writ of inquisition over mustering an army in two seasons.

Sermersuaq.t: The Synod upheld a writ to permanently consecrate the Beacons of Sermersuaq to Vigilance, which the Stormcrows backed in memory of the Jotun invasion. The Wintermark Assembly called for a mediator for the Atalaq tradehall.

The Barrens.t: A veto against ceding the Last Battle Wayhouse to the Karass failed, and a mandate sent pilgrims to the Barrens, creating an opportunity to restore its people's dignity and prosperity. The roads appraisal was ordered to restart, and the Hounds of Glory's final path was recognised as a pilgrimage route.

Tsirku.t: Wintermark named a newly scouted region the Fractured Silence and the Great Pit Firefall. A Varushkan mandate to gather Tsirku's treasures was not enacted, and a condemnation of the Whisper Gallery's agents there was withdrawn.

Archive:376YE Winter Solstice Imperial t.d: Each Imperial territory's senator and each army's general were listed. League bishops took four cardinalships (Ambition, Loyalty, Prosperity and The Way), and Gralka of the Imperial Orcs became Conscience of the Senate. Six archmagi were declared, and the order grandmasters were to serve with fixed voting strengths until the Spring Equinox 377YE. Because of concerns about economic stability in a time of Imperial crisis, Bourse seats won at this summit were to run until Winter 377YE. The Brilliant Shore, the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by Thule and the Druj and would not be auctioned until their territories were Imperial again.

Dawn.t: Dawn's three senators were listed, along with Generals Floree de Rondell, Eryk Rykker and Frederick Novarion of the Hounds of Glory, Golden Sun and Eastern Sky.

Druj.t: The Druj held the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, and neither would be auctioned until Reikos and Holberg were Imperial again.

Highguard.t: Highguard's senators and Generals Matthias and Ruth were listed, alongside gatekeepers Asher (Courage) and Abraham (Vigilance), Grandmaster Jessica of the Sevenfold Path and Obediah holding the Vigilant Swan.

Imperial Orcs.t: Generals Klor of the Winter Sun and Braka of the Summer Storm sat on the Military Council, and Gralka was appointed Conscience of the Senate.

Navarr.t: Alongside its senators and two generals, Navarr provided the Cardinals of Courage and Wisdom, the Pride gatekeeper, Grandmaster Meir Pathfinder of the Rod and Shield and the holder of the Thimble.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn senators were listed, with Madruga's seat later proxied by Yalda i Ezmara i Erigo. Generals Yasmina and Deigo were also listed, and Darius i Esmara i Erigo became gatekeeper of the Prosperity Assembly.

The League.t: The League dominated the Synod with four cardinalships and held many Imperial Bourse seats, the Regario Dossier and the Mastery of the Imperial Mint. Its senators and General Stanislav Krieger of the Wolves of War were also listed.

The Marches.t: Marcher Langdon Tor became Cardinal of Pride, and Silent John and Alan Young were made gatekeepers. William Bolholt led the Golden Pyramid with a voting strength of 76, and the Marches' senators and three generals were listed.

Thule.t: Thule held the Brilliant Shore, which would not be auctioned until Skarsind was once again an Imperial territory.

Urizen.t: Urizen's three senators were listed, along with General Decius Cascade of the Citadel Guard and Valerion of Phoenix Reach, who held the Legacy.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained the Cardinal of Vigilance and the Wisdom gatekeeper, and Alexei became Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind. It also held two national Bourse seats, and its senators and two generals were listed.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's senators were listed, along with Generals Merrick and Erkenbrand of the Green Shield and Fist of the Mountain, and Wyrda Bjornadottir, Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern with a voting strength of 63.

Archive:376YE Winter Solstice Imperial t.o: This was the roll of Imperial titles held at the Winter Solstice of 376YE, listing the senators, generals, Synod cardinals and gatekeepers, Conclave archmagi and grandmasters, and holders of Bourse positions.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Great Pits of Ennerlund remained in Druj hands and were withheld from the Bourse auction until Holberg was once again an Imperial territory.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Bohemond De Rondell was listed as its senator.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: Simiel of the Shattered Tower was listed as its senator.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: Richard of Bourholt was listed as its senator.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Cyrus of Felix's Watch was listed as its senator.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: Salur was listed as its senator.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hengest Dun was listed as its senator.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Cei Windstrider was listed as its senator.

Holberg.t: With Holberg in Druj hands, the Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until the territory was Imperial again.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: Raul was listed as its senator.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: Uskolli was listed as its senator.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Constantin was listed as its senator.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: Zeref i Ezmara i Erigo was listed as its senator, later proxied by Yalda i Ezmara i Erigo.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Bledri Eternal was listed as its senator.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Yelislaveta Syrnova Vlanich was listed as its senator.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Bridget Talbot was listed as its senator.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Ioseph was listed as its senator.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Adamah of the Silent Tide was listed as its senator.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Probus was listed as its senator.

Reikos.t: The Great Forest at Reikos was held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until Reikos was once again an Imperial territory.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: Miroslav was listed as its senator.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Ywain De Gauvain was listed as its senator.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Atte was listed as its senator.

Skarsind.t: The Brilliant Shore was held by the Thule and would not be auctioned until Skarsind was once again an Imperial territory.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: Arsenio Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato was listed as its senator.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: Oksana Kazaku von Temeschwar was listed as its senator.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: Caerwyn Summer Crow was listed as its senator.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Henry Ward was listed as its senator.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Maxim was listed as its senator.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Marek was listed as its senator, and the Weirwater Vales Bourse seat was held by John Marsh.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: Hector Cascade was listed as its senator.

Construct Madruga shipyard.d: The motion was proposed by the senator for Sarvos and seconded by the senator for Madruga. Construction required 35 wains of white granite and 5 wains of weirwood, with an upkeep of 5 thrones. Mirislav, Senator for Sarvos, paid the costs during the Spring Equinox 377YE downtime. Once built, the shipyard means that every Freeborn fleet operating out of Madruga produces more wealth for its owner. The total benefit is 720 rings per season, divided among all the fleets active in Madruga that season.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn fleet owners sailing from Madruga share an extra 720 rings each season from the new shipyard, strengthening the nation's maritime wealth.

The League.t: The League's senator for Sarvos proposed the shipyard and then paid its construction costs, effectively funding a Freeborn project.

Construct Madruga shipyard.o: In Winter 376YE the Senate passed a motion to build a new Imperial shipyard in Madruga, intended to increase the wealth produced by Freeborn fleets sailing from that territory.

Madruga.t: Madruga gains a new Imperial shipyard, and the fleets operating from it share 720 additional rings of wealth each season.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos's senator, Mirislav, proposed the motion and personally paid the materials for a shipyard built in another territory.

Cost.d: With thirty thousand Imperial champions and allies from the Summer and Winter realms, the Empire faced nearly a dozen Druj armies, the Black Wind, and the Rivers Run Red curse. A slave uprising aided by the Winter Sun took the Fangs mithril mine, which the rebels now hold against the Empire. At the Shadowmere, Druj ambushers failed to kill a single Citadel Guard soldier, and the Saltmarsh fell. The Vendarri later sought terms of surrender. The Hounds of Glory marched on to the Plains of Teeth and led a desperate charge into the Spires of Dusk. More than fifteen thousand Druj fell, but the Druj still hold the forests. Five Sentinel Gate conjunctions followed.

Dawn.t: All four Dawnish armies fought, and the Hounds of Glory turned near-rout into victory by charging into the Spires of Dusk, which destroyed the army; the Black Wind singled out Dawnish soldiers, and the dead are to be brought home to Astolat, Semmerholm and Weirwater.

Druj.t: The Druj lost the Bitter Strand, the Saltmarsh, the Plains of Teeth and their great fortress the Spires of Dusk, and more than fifteen thousand Mallum orcs will not fight again, though they still hold the Barrens' forests and plot revenge.

Highguard.t: The Seventh Wave scouted for the armies and, with the Winter Sun, persuaded the Vendarri first to stay neutral and then to seek surrender; the Vendarri are now in discussion with the Highborn over Saltmarsh, and Highborn soldiers were among the thousand who died at the Shadowmere.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Winter Sun came south from Ossium to break the Druj's chains, slipping disguised infiltrators into the Fangs to arm the Rahvin remnants and spark the slave uprising, and later helping to win over the Vendarri.

Navarr.t: Mentioned in passing: Navarr bands fought alongside the Hounds of Glory, and Navarr soldiers saw echoes of the Holt of the Oak in the weirwood of the Spires of Dusk.

The League.t: The Wolves of War fought an inconclusive running battle with the Hunting Scorpion, while the Towerjacks helped flank the Druj ambush at the Shadowmere and joined the advance on the Spires of Dusk.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard came from liberated Zenith and, shielded by Winter magic, lost not a single soldier in the whole campaign, surviving the Shadowmere ambush untouched while the casualties fell on other armies.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe and the Northern Eagle fought through the campaign, with Varushkan soldiers among the thousand dead at the Shadowmere; the Bargainer of the Iron Tower is responsible for a conjunction to recover a cache of Druj mithril.

Wintermark.t: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark bands fought with the Hounds of Glory, and Winterfolk soldiers advised their comrades on crossing the flooded fens of Saltmarsh.

Cost.o: In Spring 385YE eleven Imperial armies drove the Druj from the Bitter Strand, the Saltmarsh and the Plains of Teeth in the Barrens and stormed the Spires of Dusk. The victory cost Dawn the Hounds of Glory, whose army was destroyed in securing the fortress.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: Mentioned in passing: veterans of Exile in Reikos remember the bitter lessons of underestimating the Druj.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: A small Druj force escorting the Amaranthine Devourer is moving through Axmure towards the Pits of Brychel, and the Knight-protector of Winter is asked to stop it at Melusine's Fields.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Empire won the Bitter Strand after days of bloody fighting, helped by the slave uprising at the Fangs, but the mithril mine is held by Rahvin-led rebels who refuse the Empire entry; a conjunction against heralds of Arhallogen opens at Spinner's Retreat.

The Barrens/Farweald.t: Mentioned in passing: Druj magic twists the forests of Farweald against any Imperial soldiers who pursue them there.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: After a miserable campaign in the flooded, cursed fens, the Empire won the Saltmarsh at the battle of the Shadowmere; the Vendarri sept has sought terms of surrender, and a conjunction to seize Raguk Chainforger's stockpile opens at the Steadfast Pines.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: The scattered Druj regrouped in the shadows of the Bleaks to strike at the Battle of Dusk and then fell back behind its magical wards; a conjunction against Zortog Ashtouch opens at the Blooming Grove.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Astolat is one of the places to which the Dawnish dead are to be brought home.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Spires of Dusk are compared to the Silent Sentinel in Casinea.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks arrived fresh from a triumphal procession through Holberg, and Raguk Chainforger's wealth is likened to that of Holberg's merchant princes.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj het Ortgut Spirebreaker is named for toppling spires in Morrow and Zenith.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Winter Sun came south after driving the Druj from Ossium, and the Spires of Dusk dwarf the broken Tower of the Scorpion there.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the citadel of Exile and the lessons learned in Reikos are recalled, and a few cases of Reikos flux appeared in the Saltmarsh.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The Druj tepel Zortog Ashtouch is retreating towards the ghulai of Leen with a list of regios, and the Polemarch of Highwatch is asked to intercept him at a Sentinel Gate conjunction.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: Sarvos appears only in the name of Jean Di Sarvos, General of the Wolves of War.

Semmerholm.t: Druj of the White Lion are escorting the Amaranthine Devourer, a herald of Agramant, through Semmerholm towards the Pits of Brychel, and Semmerholm is one of the places the Dawnish dead will be brought home.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bronzehoard reavers went into the Barrens to find goods to sell to the orcs of Skarsind.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: light infantry companies from Tassato fought Druj chikad as part of the Wolves of War.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Spires of Dusk are said to echo the walls of Temeschwar.

The Barrens.t: The Empire took the Bitter Strand, the Saltmarsh, the Plains of Teeth and the Spires of Dusk, so it now holds five regions here, though the Druj keep the forests and the Rivers Run Red curse still blights the land.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: the weirwood of the Spires of Dusk recalls the Holt of the Oak in Therunin.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater is one of the places to which the Dawnish dead are to be brought home.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: the Citadel Guard came from Zenith, freed but not healed, and the Eastern Sky drew inspiration from its people.

Disburse funds for Iron Helms III.d: The motion sought Senate funds to finish raising the Iron Helms army, which the Senate had commissioned in Autumn 379YE. It was the third such funding motion, following two earlier ones. Proposed by the senator for Karsk and seconded by Hahnmark, it passed in principle and was approved at 200 thrones. The 200 thrones were then disbursed to the senator for Karsk to put towards the army's completion.

Varushka.t: Varushka moved closer to fielding a new army, the Iron Helms, as 200 thrones went to its senator for Karsk to help complete it.

Disburse funds for Iron Helms III.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Karsk and seconded by Hahnmark, to disburse 200 thrones towards completing the Iron Helms army in Karsk, Varushka.

Karsk.t: The Iron Helms army was being raised in Karsk, and the territory's senator proposed the motion and received the 200 thrones disbursed to complete it.

Good apples.d: Following a Marcher Assembly judgement citing a true aura on Bastard Tom of Stoke as Good Walder's inspiration, rumours of the paragon spread across the Marches, and villages decorated old apple trees they claimed were his grave. In the Golden Downs, just south of Hay near the Mourn border, the oldest tree in a copse said to mark Walder's grave, and all its neighbours, became heavy with fruit. The friars proposed a folly (5 wains of white granite, 10 crowns) creating the title Keeper of Good Walder's Grave, or a larger sinecure shrine yielding liao and Synod votes. Alternatively, the site could become an inspirational tomb using true liao. None was commissioned during the Summer Solstice, but the opportunities remain open.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: Good Walder's lessons are said to be preached in Highguard today.

The Marches.t: Marcher villages across several territories are claiming a part in Walder's story, and the friars of Hay asked that the Marcher Assembly, or at a stretch the Prosperity Assembly, appoint any Keeper of Good Walder's Grave.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: Walder's warnings about good hospitality are said to be appreciated as far afield as Varushka.

Wintermark.t: Mentioned in passing: Walder's stories were told in Wintermark long before there was an Empire.

Good apples.o: After rumours spread that Good Walder's ghost had appeared at Anvil, an old apple copse near Hay in the Golden Downs of Mitwold, long said to mark his grave, burst into miraculous fruit. The friars of Hay proposed honouring the site with a folly, a larger shrine sinecure or an inspirational memorial.

Mitwold/Golden Downs.t: Just south of Hay, an old apple copse said to be Walder's grave is groaning with fruit, and it could host a folly, a sinecure shrine or an inspirational tomb if the resources are provided.

Bregasland.t: A few places in Bregasland have joined in the rumours, reminding passers-by of their village's part in Walder's story.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold is home to the miraculous apple copse near Hay, where the friars proposed a folly, shrine or memorial to Good Walder, none of which has yet been built.

Mournwold.t: Even a couple of pubs in the Mourn are claiming a part in Walder's story, and the miraculous copse lies near the Mourn border.

Upwold.t: Several places in Upwold are claiming a part in Walder's story and tying ribbons to ancient apple trees said to mark his grave.

Research Purifying Flame.d: The motion, proposed by Casinea and seconded by the Conscience of the Senate, sought research into the activities, goals and members of the Society of the Purifying Flame. The research was to begin with the lives of Benedict Di Tassato, Mario De Regiario and their known associates around 270–300YE and trace the society up to the present day. It was classed as historical research costing 5 thrones. Its progress was recorded as unknown, and the stated outcome was that a report on the Purifying Flame would be compiled and delivered to the Senator for Casinea.

The League.t: The research was put forward by the Senator for Casinea, a League senator, who was to receive the finished report on the Society of the Purifying Flame.

Research Purifying Flame.o: In Winter 378YE the Senate motion proposed by Casinea's senator commissioned historical research into the secretive Society of the Purifying Flame, at a cost of 5 thrones.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the territory appears only in the name of Benedict Di Tassato, one of the historical figures whose life was the starting point for the research.

Some kind of trouble.d: Four major conjunctions were listed. Two on Saturday would channel Thule ritual magic to destroy a fortification at Pyhatunturi in Sermersuaq, perhaps reducing Cathan Canae's aid to the Jotun, and intercept a Lasambrian Jotun and Yegarra force seeking to take Rojota and a beachhead in Gambit. Two on Sunday targeted the Druj in Zenith: destroying miasma pillars with Zakalwe's aid and intercepting ghulai supplying the Tainted Basilisk ritualists. Fifteen large conjunctions covered exorcisms, raids, the Skallahn spy network, the vallorn in Brocéliande and Casinea, and winter regio work. Three small conjunctions involved rescues and selecting heroes for the Summer Tourney.

Dawn.t: In Dawn's Semmerholm, Hayaak chose five people to organise teams at the Forest of Affray to select heroes for the Summer Tourney.

Druj.t: The Druj were the enemy at both Sunday major conjunctions in Zenith, where Imperial forces aimed to destroy their miasma pillars and intercept ghulai supplying the Tainted Basilisk ritualists. A further opportunity in the Druj-held Forest of Ulnak sought to enable the return of Imperial soldiers.

Grendel.t: The Hand of Guerra had an opportunity to rescue several Zemress Islanders in the Afar Hills of Grendel-held Feroz.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Casinea faced the vallorn, with the General of the Towerjacks deciding how to combat it in Mareholm. A fallen Highguard Exarch was also to be exorcised in Zenith.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were the main foe: Yegarra-aided forces in Sermersuaq faced Thule ritual magic against a fortification, Lasambrian raiders threatened Kahraman, and a Jotun warband was to be defeated in Bregasland. Imperial preparations for a raid on Jotun-held Skallahn were also under way.

The Brass Coast.t: Kahraman was threatened by a Lasambrian Jotun and Yegarra push on Rojota and Gambit, which the Empire sought to intercept. In Segura, missions were planned to rescue a lost magistrate and magicians taken by the Iron Confederacy.

The Marches.t: The Senator for Bregasland was to lead an attack on a Jotun warband in the Grey Fens to counter Mathilda Fisher's propaganda. In Mitwold, the Shuttered Lantern was to hide preparations for the Skallahn raid.

Thule.t: Thule ritual magic was to be channelled by Imperial forces to destroy a Jotun fortification at Pyhatunturi in Sermersuaq.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's Sermersuaq saw a major battle against the Jotun and Yegarra, a raid on a mithril mine and an effort to enlist the Hylje. Kallavesa's West Marsh hosted work to keep the Skallahn spy network secret.

Some kind of trouble.o: For the Spring Equinox 384YE summit, the civil service's prognosticators published the Sentinel Gate conjunctions they had identified, ranging from major battles against the Jotun, Yegarra and Druj to smaller missions against the vallorn, spy operations and rescues.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: At Dank Mere, a Jotun warband was to be defeated to counter Mathilda Fisher's propaganda.

Brocéliande/Black Boughs.t: A steading at the Black Hearth Wayhouse was to be defended from attack.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: Vallornspawn near a regio at Broch's Approach were to be dispersed under the Advisor on the Vallorn.

Casinea/Mareholm.t: The General of the Towerjacks was to decide how to combat the vallorn at Holmwood or Vale's Fast.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Several Zemress Islanders were to be rescued in the Afar Hills by the Hand of Guerra.

Forest of Ulnak/Oerwealt.t: A conjunction at the Beetle Tree aimed to enable the return of Imperial soldiers.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Yegarra and Lasambrian Jotun sought a beachhead here, and Lasambrian raiders were to be made an example of at Redhill Pastures.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: At Starkmarsh, the Imperial Spymaster was to maintain the secrecy of the Skallahn spy network.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: At Steward's Landing, the Shuttered Lantern was to hide preparations for the Skallahn raid.

Segura/Anduzjasse.t: Two rescues were planned: a magistrate lost investigating smugglers at Kabalai Campo and magicians held by the Iron Confederacy at Kalino Watch.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: The Forest of Affray was the site where heroes for the Summer Tourney were to be selected.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: A major battle at Pyhatunturi aimed to destroy a Jotun fortification with Thule magic, and a raid on a mithril mine was to be supported at Ikka's Trail.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: The Mediator of Hyljehal was to enlist the help of the Hylje at Lansipari Pines.

Zenith/Clypion.t: Clypion saw the effort to destroy Druj miasma pillars with Zakalwe's aid at the Bulwark of Lutum, alongside the exorcism of a lost Urizeni seer, manipulation of a winter regio and warding against winter spirits.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The Master of the School of Exorcism was to exorcise a fallen Highguard Exarch at the Ceramic Meander.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Imperial forces were to intercept ghulai bringing vital resources to the Tainted Basilisk ritualists at the Fields of Resplendent Twilight.

Bregasland.t: A Jotun warband at Dank Mere was to be defeated, under the Senator for Bregasland, to combat Mathilda Fisher's propaganda.

Brocéliande.t: Imperial forces aimed to disperse vallornspawn near a regio at Broch's Approach and to defend a steading at the Black Hearth Wayhouse.

Casinea.t: The General of the Towerjacks was to decide how to combat the vallorn at Holmwood or Vale's Fast in Mareholm.
