Feroz.t: The Hand of Guerra had a small conjunction to rescue several Zemress Islanders in the Afar Hills.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The Imperial Spymaster had a conjunction at the Beetle Tree in Oerwealt to enable the return of Imperial soldiers.

Kahraman.t: A Lasambrian Jotun and Yegarra force threatened to take Rojota and secure a beachhead in Gambit, and Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills was to make an example of Lasambrian raiders at Redhill Pastures.

Kalino.t: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Confederacy, which held Kalino, had taken magicians whom the Celestial Arch sought to rescue from Kalino Watch in Segura.

Kallavesa.t: The Imperial Spymaster was to maintain the secrecy of the Skallahn spy network at Starkmarsh in the West Marsh.

Mitwold.t: The Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern was to hide preparations for the Skallahn raid at Steward's Landing in Oddmire.

Segura.t: A magistrate lost investigating smugglers was to be rescued at Kabalai Campo, and magicians were to be rescued from the Iron Confederacy at Kalino Watch.

Semmerholm.t: Heroes for the Summer Tourney were to be selected at the Forest of Affray in Axmure, with Hayaak choosing five people to organise teams.

Sermersuaq.t: Thule ritual magic was to destroy a Jotun fortification at Pyhatunturi, possibly reducing Cathan Canae's aid to the Jotun, while other missions supported a mithril mine raid and sought the Hylje's help.

Skallahn.t: A Skallahn spy network and preparations for a raid on the territory were being protected by conjunctions in Kallavesa and Mitwold.

Zenith.t: Zenith hosted both Sunday major battles against the Druj and several large conjunctions to exorcise lost Highguard and Urizeni souls, manipulate a winter regio and ward against winter spirits.

Watching my mistakes.d: The Wintermark Assembly had settled that former thralls could reweave their skeins, but many resistance fighters had survived through pacts with Blood-on-the-Snow. Four non-exclusive options, open only during the Winter Solstice, were set out: a Senate motion for sweeping magistrate investigations, costing Sermersuaq's military units two ranks for two seasons; a Synod investigation by the Silent Bell; a Conclave declaration sending the Shuttered Lantern to study the Howler's boons; or a Wintermark Assembly mandate sending priests to seek out offenders. Monsters from Agramant and Hayaak also roamed the territory. The proposed Hall of the Hunters (12 white granite, 3 thrones) would yield 9 mana and a monster-hunting paid work option.

Jotun.t: The Jotun have been driven from Sermersuaq, leaving behind their castles, thousands of cairns and the rune-carved stone markers that failed to keep the Howler's monsters out.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the opening story's Wintermark hunter bought her wolf-hound from a dog-training shop in Holberg.

Thule.t: The Thule warlocks gathered at Tanikipari were massacred by Hayaak's followers in Autumn 384YE, and the Griffon-King's monsters then scattered across Sermersuaq.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark is whole again but must decide how to deal with Winterfolk who made pacts with Blood-on-the-Snow; its Assembly could send priests to root them out and appoint a Banner-Bearer of Atkonaroq if the Hall of the Hunters is built.

Watching my mistakes.o: With the Jotun driven out of Sermersuaq, Wintermark faced the legacy of their rule: resistance fighters who had made pacts with Blood-on-the-Snow, and monsters from the Winter and Summer realms loose in the wilds. The Empire was offered several ways to root out the Whisperer's allies during the Winter Solstice, and a proposal to build a hunting hall in the Suaq Wastes.

Sermersuaq/Sealtoq.t: Mentioned in passing: the respected Kallavesi magistrate Heorl Thunderspeaker, based in Sealtoq, could conduct any trials arising from a Wintermark Assembly mandate.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: The Hall of the Hunters was proposed for the shore of Lake Atkonaroq in the Suaq Wastes, as a base for heroes hunting the monsters of Blood-on-the-Snow and Hayaak, producing 9 mana a season.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: Hayaak's army slaughtered the Thule warlocks gathered at Tanikipari in Autumn 384YE, and his monsters afterwards scattered across the territory rather than returning to the Summer realm.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: some Wintermarkers escaped the Jotun conquest of Sermersuaq by fleeing to Hahnmark.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the hound in the opening story was bought from a dog-training shop in Holberg.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: some Wintermarkers escaped the Jotun conquest of Sermersuaq by fleeing to Kallavesa.

Sermersuaq.t: Back under Imperial control, Sermersuaq faces possible investigations into cultists of Blood-on-the-Snow and is troubled by Winter and Summer monsters that a proposed Hall of the Hunters could keep at bay.
